_doc: The founding choice (ROADMAP §9.7, R119). Measured on a fresh save, the starter herd was a literal ['goat','goat','bear'] with the goats newborn, so the only animal graduatable on day one was the bear — and a graduation yields six parts from ONE species. The Theater therefore opened with exactly one creature anybody could build. A lab is three things: a GROWN DONOR (extractable immediately, the day-one door A4 opened), a BREEDABLE JUVENILE PAIR, and a CRATE of two parts from a third species. THE CRATE HOLDS NO HEAD, deliberately: a head is mandatory to splice, so a crate with one lets a new player build a two-part creature out of the crate alone before meeting the extractor. Without one, the sequence A4 fixed holds — graduate, THEN splice. It is the forelimbs and hindlimbs because those most change an animal and, measured, decide whether it can fight. THE CHOICE CHANGES WHICH CREATURE, NEVER HOW MUCH: three animals, one grown, all Standard, under every lab. Against the second node the five read 0% with one chimera and 96/96/92/100/100% with three, so A1's wall holds and R106's promise is true whichever you pick. That balance was searched, not guessed. Adding a sixth lab is this file and nothing else.

labs.name: The Bramble Barn
labs.blurb: Inherited from an aunt who asked no questions. Smells of hay and ozone.
labs.pitch: A bear on the slab and a crate of eagle. Graduate the bear for a head, then give it wings.

labs.name: The Wetwing Annexe
labs.blurb: Half greenhouse, half aquarium, entirely uninsured.
labs.pitch: A heron to graduate, geese coming up, and a crate of mantis limbs that came with the greenhouse.

labs.name: The Nightshift Loft
labs.blurb: You work when the neighbours do not. This is not a coincidence.
labs.pitch: A bat on the slab and a tiger's legs in a crate. Nobody is going to sleep through this.

labs.name: The Slab
labs.blurb: One long table, one drain, excellent lighting.
labs.pitch: Armour first, from the tortoise. The crocodile in the crate supplies everything that grips.

labs.name: The Kennel
labs.blurb: The howling is structural. The council has been told it is pipes.
labs.pitch: A wolf to graduate and a rhino's legs in a crate. We call it a kennel for the paperwork.
